title: Resolved CE smart cuts compute the derived truncation spectral object
statement: For an abelian category A, Grothendieck abelian categories B and C equipped with derived categories, and additive F:A→B and G:B→C and every Cartan–Eilenberg presentation P of F, construct a morphism from the cohomology mapping-cone spectral object of the totals of mapped CE smart cuts to H RG of the canonical truncation spectral object of Q(F(P.J)). Its components on bottom intervals are invertible and it is natural for every specified presentation comparison. This asserts no comparison with RF(P.X) and involves no filtration or decalage.

source.document: Stacks Project, Homological Algebra and Derived Categories
source.place: Tags 0118, 0156, 015K and 015X; the indicated proof steps of the CE comparison.

proof.text: Finite diagonals identify the total of each mapped CE smart cut with G of its total.

The uniquely normalized truncated CE augmentations give injective resolutions, commuting with cutoff and presentation maps by cancellation and the total-coordinate formulas. Their cone squares compute RG naturally by the inverse derived unit.

The unique cochain/derived truncation comparison identifies the localized smart-cut tower with canonical upper truncations. Compare interval cone triangles using t-structure orthogonality, and compare triple-cutoff octahedral triangles to fix the connecting maps. Include zero and full-total endpoints and apply cohomology; the bottom components are isomorphisms.

theorem cartanEilenberg_smartTruncation_spectralObject_comparison
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [Abelian A]
    (F : A ⥤ B) (G : B ⥤ C) [F.Additive] [G.Additive] :
    ∃ e : ∀ P : CartanEilenbergPresentation F,
      (cochainTowerSpectralObjectFunctor C).obj
          (CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedSmartTruncationTower G P.I) ⟶
        (derivedTruncationSpectralObjectFunctor G).obj
          (DerivedCategory.Plus.Q.obj (F.specifiedResolutionComplex P.J)),
      (∀ (P : CartanEilenbergPresentation F) (n : ℤ) (b : EInt),
        IsIso (((e P).hom n).app (ComposableArrows.mk₁
          (homOfLE (bot_le : (⊥ : EInt) ≤ b))))) ∧
      ∀ (P Q : CartanEilenbergPresentation F) (d : P.Comparison Q),
        (cochainTowerSpectralObjectFunctor C).map
            (CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedSmartTruncationTowerMap G d.α) ≫ e Q =
          e P ≫ (derivedTruncationSpectralObjectFunctor G).map
            (DerivedCategory.Plus.Q.map (ObjectProperty.homMk
              ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
                (HomologicalComplex.extendMap d.β ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)) :
              F.specifiedResolutionComplex P.J ⟶ F.specifiedResolutionComplex Q.J))
